detail.longDescription: Butterfly 2.6.4-rc.0 is here, and this update has grown quite a bit larger than expected! So while this is still a patch release, there’s quite a lot to talk about. Highlights: 🚀 Flutter 3.50 and platform updates 📄 Redesigned PDF import dialog ✏️ Better stylus and touch handling 📋 Important clipboard and asset fixes 🎨 Drawing and usability improvements Read more here: https://www. linwood.dev/butterfly/2.6.4-rc .0/ # flutter # opensource # productivity
